limitations: Coverage is the enclosing z14 tile rectangle, not a polygon clip.
MVT is processed OpenMapTiles-schema content, not raw/full OSM.
Release ID date is 2026-08-30; official osm_date is 2026-08-24.

service_usage_basis.method: 357 bounded requests, at most four concurrent, no retry loops
service_usage_basis.statement: Using our public instance is completely free: there are no limits on the number of map views or requests.

scope_statement: A bounded Seoul z14 OpenFreeMap vector-tile extraction plus separately dated editable BBBike OSM, Mapzen terrain, and historical KOSTAT 2013 district boundaries. This is not an all-zoom or complete raw OSM snapshot.

attribution: SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
Global ETOPO1 terrain data U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
